environment: Local headless Chromium through DevTools Protocol
method: Automated semantic/AX-tree, contrast, real keyboard event, state, bilingual stress, forced-colors, emulated touch, reflow-equivalent, no-JavaScript, motion, Save-Data, and constrained-profile checks

detail.method: Chromium accessibility tree inspection; not a human screen-reader session
Computed solid-background text contrast; gradients and anti-aliasing excluded
Real CDP Tab and Enter key events on every artifact
Controlled geometry/stress fixtures only; no linguistic approval
Chromium forced-colors media emulation plus focus/border geometry
Emulated touch tap and moved scroll gesture; no physical dialer/device
Chromium CSS-viewport/device-scale emulation; browser UI zoom controls were not manually operated
Navigator Save-Data override before document creation
Chromium 6× CPU throttle and 400 ms / 400 kbps local HTTP profile
Initial Home document plus loaded local dependency file sizes, uncompressed (conservative versus compressed limits)
